input.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.total_consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS percent
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth
  GROUP BY CustomerID
) t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
